title: Understanding Variance
text: What happens to the variance of a model when you increase the number of data points?

title: Effect of More Data
text: Increasing the number of data points generally leads to a decrease in variance. This is because the model has more information to learn from, reducing the impact of any single data point.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Given that increasing the number of data points decreases variance, does collecting $$100$$ more sample points decrease variance?
